title.zh: 图形转移：光刻画图，刻蚀落图
title.en: Pattern transfer: lithography draws, etching transfers

subtitle.en: CD, overlay, mask budget, selectivity and profile jointly determine the result

body.zh: 光刻胶；（Resist）；硬掩膜；（Hard Mask）；目标膜；（Target Film）；衬底；（Substrate）；Mask
body.en: Photoresist (Resist) Hard mask (Hard Mask) Target film (Target Film) Substrate (Substrate) Mask

body.zh: 光刻胶（Resist）；硬掩膜（Hard Mask，可选）；目标膜（Target Film）；衬底（Substrate）
body.en: Photoresist (Resist) Hard mask (optional) Target film Substrate

body.zh: Mask CD → Resist CD → Etch Bias →；Final CD
body.en: Mask CD → Resist CD → Etch Bias → Final CD

body.zh: 光刻胶图形是临时模板，最终结构由光刻与刻蚀共同完成。
body.en: Resist is a temporary template; lithography and etching jointly form the final structure
1. Four control windows CD Overlay Focus–dose Selectivity and profile

body.zh: 2. 关键耦合；更薄Resist：；分辨率潜力 ↑；Mask Budget ↓
body.en: 2. Key coupling Thinner resist: resolution potential ↑ mask budget ↓

body.zh: Final CD =；Litho CD + Etch Bias；（示意关系）
body.en: Final CD = Litho CD + Etch Bias (schematic relationship)

body.zh: 3. 常见失效；Scum残胶；Pattern Collapse；Overlay 偏移；Bowing；Undercut；Etch Residue
body.en: 3. Common failures Scum residue Pattern collapse Overlay shift Bowing Undercut Etch residue

body.zh: 量测反馈：CDSEM / Overlay / XSEM / Defect Inspection；CDSEM（线宽量测）；Overlay（叠层量测）；XSEM（剖面检查）；Defect Inspection；（缺陷检測）
body.en: Metrology feedback: CDSEM / overlay / XSEM / defect inspection CDSEM (linewidth metrology) Overlay (layer alignment metrology) XSEM (cross-sectional inspection) Defect inspection (defect inspection)

body.zh: 胶层异常；回查Coat/Expose/Develop；判定；膜层异常；回查Mask/Etch/Clean
body.en: Resist-layer anomaly Trace back to coat/expose/develop Decision Film-layer anomaly Trace back to mask/etch/clean

body.zh: 影响：器件尺寸漂移 / Contact Open / 相邻结构Short
body.en: Impact: device dimensional drift / open contacts / shorts between adjacent structures

body.zh: 正胶、负胶、化学放大胶和多重图形化路线，步骤与窗口会不同。
body.en: Positive, negative and chemically amplified resists and multipatterning routes have different steps and windows
